experiment_conditioning: One source law per paper; 5 views are dependent; physical x not automatically observed.

typed_definitions.x: signed state/observable carrier with frame, units, time/redshift, source index, complete covariance and source transfer
typed_definitions.Q: Minkowski gauge of physically justified convex feasible body, or separately labelled Q_stat under explicit reference
typed_definitions.Pi: matched law tail of named event/statistic; missing source null => UNCALIBRATED
typed_definitions.F: physical-body-normalized finite measure occupancy F_(mu,K)(E), or specifically registered alternate F_E(K) ellipsoid-normalized; choose denominator
typed_definitions.G_F: difference of physically comparable, source/observer transported occupancies with cross-epoch law; unavailable otherwise
typed_definitions.auxiliary: STF chi, F_Omega sky area, parameter identified-set support and G_x are auxiliary; no independent likelihood

p1.observable_x: Original P1 selected 274-row 15D signed coefficient with four covariance shapes, not a local GR shear
p1.comparator_x: R62 CF4 apparent 15D J2 coefficient, STF first 5; separate source, not selected P1
p1.physical_x_target: H=Theta/3,d=-A/c,S=sigma STF5 at a source-qualified local vertex
p1.Q_phys: Q_H= - min_n(d.n+n S n)/H for H>0; strict Q_H<1 => all directions local vertex expansion positive
p1.Pi: P1 selected Gaussian common-unknown-scale F law, do not replace by R62 fixed chi-square; R62 Gaussian comparator separate
p1.F: F_(mu,K_H)(selected physical confidence region) only after optical physical transfer plus finite mu; F_Omega(S) deterministic function chi under full sky
p1.G_F: GR shear+normal congruence transport and same-source F history required; apparent depth G_x not GF
p1.theorem: R73-T1 robust minimum of H(n) over source-qualified ellipsoid and sky; QH + chi fixes unordered spectrum when d=0, not eigenframe
p1.next_analysis: Qualify P1 optical coefficient/calibration map, then propagate original full 15D selected confidence region through it

p2.observable_x: R66 finite-band PR3/PR4 radiation pi_gamma/rho signed STF5; matching flux missing
p2.physical_x_target: photon (f_i,S_gamma_ij) moments in one tetrad, 8D plus source kinetic transport
p2.Q_phys: Q_stress=max(0,-3 min eigenvalue(S)); mixed Q_gamma from eigenvalue of [[0,sqrt3 fT],[sqrt3 f,3S]]
p2.Pi: No qualified actual Commander T/E/B MC; physical Pi unavailable
p2.F: Photon energy cap F_A constrained by PSD moments; 0<=F_A<=0.411525 at cap |nz|>.9 under current stress-only moment; full F not identified
p2.G_F: For same source and photon Boltzmann flow dF/dt= - boundary integral p V.nout - Cov_p(1A,sigma_nn-2c a.n), physical only with actual time solution
p2.theorem: R73-T3 flux P-mmT>=0 iff f in range P and fT P+ f<=1; R73-T4 cap occupancy transport
p2.next_analysis: Source-matched photon flux and high-ell moments or registered closure, actual Commander MC, then Boltzmann moment-to-occupancy validation

p3.observable_x: R64 source-dependent 68D selected CF4 Gaussian response with signed eta, eta_z, eta_zz and full covariance; V3 nuisance
p3.physical_x_target: Hcal=Theta/3+sigma_nn-A.n/c and Jacobi optical transfer; separate from HD=c/Rz
p3.Q_phys: Q_D=max(0,sup(B eta_z)) local source-defined distance-derivative domain; Q_D<1 iff D>0 full sky in selected model, not GR shear positivity
p3.Pi: R64 fixed-C Gaussian nested radial/angular test, not physical NEC/comprehensive LSS null
p3.F: F_E(K_D) for uniform joint Gaussian confidence ellipsoid and chosen angular constraints; F_Omega(D>0) is a different sky-area measure
p3.G_F: same source/frame Sachs transport and cross-depth covariance missing; R64 G_x redshift contrast is not physical GF
p3.theorem: R73-T1 explicit Gaussian negative-D boundary witness and R73-T2 exact halfspace ellipsoid cap volume
p3.actual_status: J3 at z=.08 full ellipsoid not robust 54-ray positive; one-direction exact cap >=0.9938465; F54_MC=0.9882202; not posterior
p3.next_analysis: Full source-calibration, physical Hcal optical closure and source-matched covariance; then entire-sky param confidence-feasibility and NEC joint test

p4.observable_x: R65 three-bin selected transverse log-intensity count vector (6D), registered provider peak/integrated pair (4D) and exact cross-covariance
p4.physical_x_target: Observer beta_O|S relative to radio source population, intrinsic a_b, independent matter-radiation beta_M|R
p4.Q_phys: Causal |beta|<1 only for source-identified full 3D physical beta; unavailable from current R65; Qstat=sqrt(DeltaT C^-1 Delta) separate
p4.Pi: Chi2_2 fixed-Gaussian Pi=exp(-Qstat²/2) for paired two-d contrast, NOT physical dipole anomaly PTE
p4.F: Raw empirical selected-source hemisphere fractions 0.51198,0.51279,0.51134 with R65 mask; not intrinsic full sky and not parameter-body F
p4.G_F: Peak/integrated selection or flux cut is not cosmic-time transport, physical GF unavailable
p4.theorem: R72 finite-bin Doppler k/kappa determines tied quadrupole only under source qualification; R73 common Fisher nuisance and Qstat/Pi relation
p4.next_analysis: Joint peak/integrated source IDs, spectral SED/beam morphology and kappa under same registered response, paired covariance and matched kSZ if global tilt intended

common_constraints.rank: linear target Ltheta identifiable iff ker nuisance-profiled Fisher subset ker L; nonlinear requires fibre invariance or exact source map
common_constraints.confidence: One joint ellipsoid and physical restriction, not product of individual p-values; R73-T1 exact robust support and R73-T2 explicit halfspace measure
common_constraints.measure: F_physical_body, F_ellipsoid, F_sky_area, F_selected_counts are distinct typed variants
common_constraints.transport: C_delta=Cjj+T Cii Tt-T Cij-Cji Tt, no independence shortcut
common_constraints.source_status: Four studied source laws, same-source R62/R64/R65 comparisons are not independent astrophysical replications
